relations.myth: The charcoal burner announces Jesus’s birth
relations.note: Olentzero returns from the mountain and proclaims that Jesus has been born.
Later retellings make Olentzero the surviving jentil who spreads news of Christ’s arrival.

relations.myth: Olentzero heralds the birth of God’s son
relations.note: Songs present Olentzero as herald of God’s son, without claiming kinship.
relations.source: Goizueta song in Aita Donostia archive

relations.note: Later systematization identifies Olentzero as the lone jentil survivor who announces Kixmi.
Mari Domingi works alongside Olentzero as an autonomous co-gift-bringer.
Later portrayals sometimes call her his wife or girlfriend, controversially and without traditional basis.
